description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: Patrick Mahomes II (knee) is active for Week 1 for the Kansas City Chiefs against the Denver Broncos.
items.impact: Mahomes II cleared through every obstacle in his way in recovering from a late-season knee injury in 2025-26, as the dynamic signal-caller looks to lead a revamped Kansas City offense back to the postseason beginning with the Week 1 divisional matchup against a disruptive Denver defense Monday night.
items.title: Patrick Mahomes II (knee) active for Week 1

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: Xavier Worthy (shoulder) is active for Week 1 for the Kansas City Chiefs against the Denver Broncos.
items.impact: Worthy will suit up after being able to practice throughout the week for head coach Andy Reid, joining fellow wideout Rashee Rice (knee) in offering quarterback Patrick Mahomes a full complement of weapons against a strong Denver defense Monday night.
items.title: Xavier Worthy (shoulder) active for Week 1

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: Rashee Rice (knee) is active for Week 1 for the Kansas City Chiefs against the Denver Broncos.
items.impact: Rice will suit up after progressing throughout the practice week and not suffering any issues in pregame activities, providing quarterback Patrick Mahomes with all of his pass-catching weapons against the Broncos Monday night.
items.title: Rashee Rice (knee) active for Week 1

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Seahawks say Sam Darnold has a "very unique" soft-tissue injury.
items.impact: Darnold's hip joint is unaffected. It is considered a short-term injury, meaning likely less than four weeks with him avoiding injured reserve.
items.title: Sam Darnold dealing with 'unique' soft-tissue injury

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: T.J. Sanders was a limited participant on Monday's estimated practice report.
items.impact: It is a short week for Buffalo playing on Thursday. Sanders will have to be monitored in practice the next couple of days.
items.title: T.J. Sanders (knee) limited in practice Monday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Ty Johnson was a limited participant on Monday's estimated practice report.
items.impact: It is a short week for Buffalo playing on Thursday. Johnson will have to be monitored in practice the next couple of days.
items.title: Ty Johnson (hamstring) limited in practice Monday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Jordan Hancock was a full participant on Monday's estimated practice report.
items.impact: Hancock should be good to go despite it being a short week for Buffalo.
items.title: Jordan Hancock (quad) logs full practice Monday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Bradley Chubb was a full participant on Monday's estimated practice report.
items.impact: Chubb should be good to go despite it being a short week for Buffalo.
items.title: Bradley Chubb (thumb) logs full practice Monday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Cole Bishop was a full participant on Monday's estimated practice report.
items.impact: Bishop should be good to go on a short week despite dealing with multiple injuries.
items.title: Cole Bishop (knee/groin) logs full practice Monday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Terrel Bernard was estimated as a limited participant in practice on Monday.
items.impact: Bernard is on the injury report with a calf issue. He is likely to play on Thursday against the Lions.
items.title: Terrel Bernard (calf) estimated as limited practice Monday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Christian Mahogany was estimated as a non-participant in practice on Monday.
items.impact: Mahogany left Sunday's game early with a knee injury. His status is uncertain on a short week.
items.title: Christian Mahogany (hip) estimated as missing practice Monday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Christian Izien was a full participant in Monday's estimated practice.
items.impact: Izien did not play in Week 1. He will have a chance to play on Thursday.
items.title: Christian Izien (groin) logs full practice Monday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Juice Scruggs was estimated as a limited participant in practice on Monday.
items.impact: It is an estimated injury report. Detroit has a short week playing on Thursday against the Bills.
items.title: Juice Scruggs (knee) limited in practice Monday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Blake Miller was estimated as a non-participant in practice on Monday.
items.impact: Miller is on the injury report with a knee issue. It is a short week for Detroit.
items.title: Blake Miller (knee) estimated as missing practice Monday

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: Trey Smith (hip) is active for Week 1 for the Kansas City Chiefs against the Denver Broncos.
items.impact: Smith will suit up after increasing practice activity throughout the week, providing a boost to a Kansas City offensive line without tackle Josh Simmons (back) against a disruptive Denver defensive front Monday night.
items.title: Trey Smith (hip) active for Week 1

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: Josh Simmons (back) is inactive for Week 1 for the Kansas City Chiefs against the Denver Broncos.
items.impact: Simmons will not suit up for the Monday night divisional matchup after struggling to practice throughout the week, with rookie Kahlil Benson set to protect quarterback Patrick Mahomes against an aggressive Denver defensive front Monday night.
items.title: Josh Simmons (back) inactive for Week 1

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Eagles placed OL Landon Dickerson on injured reserve.
items.impact: McLane notes that Dickerson had been playing with various ailments. He will miss at least the next four games.
items.title: Landon Dickerson placed on IR

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Isiah Pacheco (back/knee) is out for at least the next 12 weeks after undergoing surgery to remove a body that was pressing a nerve on his neck. The plan is to have him back in early December.
items.impact: It's a tough blow to Pacheco, who was already struggling with a knee injury. He's droppable in all formats, as his handcuff status for 2026 is pretty much out the window.
items.title: Isiah Pacheco (back/knee) out for 12 weeks after undergoing back surgery

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Vikings head coach O'Connell said RB Jordan Mason is being evaluated for a sore thumb.
items.impact: Mason came into the building on Monday with the injury. He is day-to-day for now after leading the backfield on Sunday.
items.title: Jordan Mason being evaluated for sore thumb

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey is dealing a rib injury and he'll be monitored throughout the week.
items.impact: McConkey was further evaluated on Monday for his injury. His status is uncertain heading into Week 2 against the Raiders.
items.title: Ladd McConkey (rib) to be monitored this week

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Raiders head coach Klint Kubiak said Brock Bowers is day-to-day.
items.impact: Bowers did not play in Sunday's season opener after undergoing a meniscus trim. His status remains uncertain for Week 2.
items.title: Brock Bowers (knee) considered day-to-day

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Ravens coach Jesse Minter said WR Zay Flowers is considered day-to-day with a hamstring injury.
items.impact: It is a good sign after Flowers left Sunday's game early after a very strong first half. His status for Week 2 still remains uncertain.
items.title: Zay Flowers (hamstring) considered day-to-day

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Frankie Luvu suffered a groin injury in Sunday's loss against the Eagles.
items.impact: The status of Luvu will need to be monitored in practice throughout the week.
items.title: Frankie Luvu suffers groin injury

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Jordan Magee is dealing with a hamstring injury from Sunday's loss against the Eagles.
items.impact: Magee pulled his hamstring trying to chase down Jalen Hurts on his long scramble in the fourth quarter. His status will need to be monitored in practice.
items.title: Jordan Magee suffers hamstring injury

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Falcons head coach Kevin Stefanski said RG Chris Lindstrom is in concussion protocol.
items.impact: Lindstrom will have to clear all protocols later in the week to be available for Week 2.
items.title: Chris Lindstrom placed in concussion protocol
